analysis.one_line_summary: Studio promotional image showing a smiling redheaded model using the pink WavyTalk Blowout Boost brush on her straight hair with headline copy addressing straight hair styling struggles.
analysis.full_description: A square static promotional image featuring the brand name 'WAVYTALK' at the top, accompanied by the bold headline 'Straight hair styling struggles? We got you.' A smiling young woman with long auburn-red hair is centered against an off-white background framed with a soft lavender border. She holds a light pink WavyTalk Blowout Boost heated round brush in both hands, wrapping a section of her straight hair around the barrel.

on_screen_text.text:
Straight hair styling struggles?
We got you.

scenes.visual: A smiling young woman with long copper-red hair holds a pink WavyTalk Blowout Boost thermal round brush horizontally against a section of her hair. Studio lighting on a clean neutral background framed by soft purple borders.
scenes.action: The model smiles looking upwards while holding the pink heated blowout brush under a section of straight hair, gripping the cool tip with her left hand and the handle with her right.
